name: AIRL Shaping + Wasserstein-GP + Cosine-BC
tagline: AIRL-shaped reward (g(s,a) + γh(s′) − h(s)) trained as a Wasserstein-GP critic, plus a cosine-annealed BC head on the policy.
formula: $$f(s,a,s') = g(s,a) + \gamma\,h(s') - h(s),\qquad \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{disc}} = -\big(\mathbb{E}_E f - \mathbb{E}_\pi f\big) + 10\,(\|\nabla f\|_2 - 1)^2,$$ $$\mathrm{reward}(s,a,s') = \mathrm{clamp}(f(s,a,s'),\,\pm 10),\qquad \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{BC}} = w_{\mathrm{BC}}\big(-\mathbb{E}_E\log\pi(a|s) - 0.001\,\mathbb{H}[\pi]\big),$$ $$w_{\mathrm{BC}} = \max\!\big(0.01,\,\tfrac{1}{2}(1+\cos(\pi\,p))\big),\quad p = \min\!\big(1, \tfrac{\text{step}}{0.75\cdot \text{total}}\big),\ \text{BC steps} = \lceil 15\,w_{\mathrm{BC}}\rceil.$$

key_hyperparams.name: bc_anneal_fraction
key_hyperparams.role: fraction of training over which BC weight cosine-decays

key_hyperparams.name: bc_floor
key_hyperparams.role: min BC weight late in training

key_hyperparams.name: n_bc_steps_max
key_hyperparams.role: max BC grad steps per IRL update

key_hyperparams.name: BC entropy bonus
key_hyperparams.role: small entropy reg in BC loss

init_recovers: Wasserstein-AIRL when w_BC = 0; AIRL when GP→0
diff_from_baseline: Versus AIRL/GAIL, swaps the BCE discriminator for a Wasserstein critic with WGAN-GP and clamps the resulting reward (±10) for PPO; layered with a cosine-annealed BC update on the policy whose step count and weight both decay over 75% of training.

name: GAIL-WGAN-GP + Behavioral Cloning Head
tagline: GAIL discriminator with label smoothing and WGAN-style gradient penalty, used as raw-logit reward; plus a behavioral cloning auxiliary loss on the policy.

key_hyperparams.name: bc_weight
key_hyperparams.role: scale of BC loss vs disc

init_recovers: GAIL when BC head removed and label smoothing = 0
diff_from_baseline: Versus GAIL, adds label-smoothing on the BCE discriminator, WGAN-GP gradient penalty, raw discriminator logit as reward, and a per-update BC step on the policy with entropy bonus.

name: AIRL Shaping + LSGAN-GP + Mean-Only BC
tagline: AIRL-shaped network trained with LSGAN loss + WGAN gradient penalty; per-update mean-only behavioral cloning on the policy (keeps policy std untouched).
formula: $$f(s,a,s') = g(s,a) + \gamma h(s') - h(s),$$ $$\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{disc}} = \tfrac{1}{2}\mathbb{E}_E (f-1)^2 + \tfrac{1}{2}\mathbb{E}_\pi (f+1)^2 + 10\,(\|\nabla f\|-1)^2,$$ $$\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{BC}} = \tfrac{1}{N}\sum_i \big\|\mu_\pi(s_i) - a^E_i\big\|^2,\quad N = 20\,\text{steps},\ \sigma_\pi\,\text{not updated}.$$

key_hyperparams.name: n_bc_steps
key_hyperparams.role: BC mean-only steps per IRL update

init_recovers: Plain AIRL when LSGAN→BCE and BC head removed
diff_from_baseline: Versus AIRL, replaces the BCE discriminator with LSGAN ((f−1)², (f+1)²) plus WGAN-GP, and runs a 20-step BC update each round that only matches the policy's action mean (not log-prob), explicitly leaving log_std unchanged to avoid variance collapse.

name: Mixture AIRL + Pairwise Margin + Conservative Cap
tagline: AIRL with a learned-gate mixture of (s,a) and (s, Δs) reward heads; trained with BCE + pairwise margin + softmax-weighted conservative penalty + WGAN-GP.
formula: $$g(s,a,s') = m\,g_{sa}(s,a) + (1-m)\,g_{sd}(s, s'-s),\quad m = \sigma(\mathrm{MLP}(s,a,\Delta s)),\quad f = g + \gamma h(s') - h(s),$$ $$\mathcal{L} = \mathrm{BCE}(D,[1-\varepsilon,\varepsilon]) + 0.2\,\mathbb{E}\,\mathrm{ReLU}(0.75 - (f_E - f_\pi)) + 0.15\,\sum_i w_i\,\mathrm{ReLU}(f_{\pi,i})^2 + 10(\|\nabla f\|-1)^2,$$ $$w_i = \mathrm{softmax}\!\big((f_{\pi,i} - \bar f_\pi)/2\big)\quad\text{(detached)}.$$

key_hyperparams.name: softmax temperature
key_hyperparams.role: softmax weight on top policy logits

key_hyperparams.name: mix_net
key_hyperparams.role: gate logit between the two heads

init_recovers: AIRL with single g(s,a) when m → 1
diff_from_baseline: Versus AIRL, replaces the single g head with a learnable mixture of (s,a) and (s, Δs) experts; trains with BCE + softened ranking margin + softmax-tilted conservative penalty on top-reward policy samples + WGAN-GP, all behind label smoothing 0.08.

name: AIRL Shaping + GAIL-GP + Strong-Entropy BC
tagline: AIRL-shaped reward, GAIL-style discriminator with label smoothing + WGAN-GP, and 12-step per-update BC with a very high entropy bonus (0.5) to prevent policy variance collapse.
formula: $$f(s,a,s') = g(s,a) + \gamma h(s') - h(s),\quad \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{disc}} = \mathrm{BCE}(D,[1-\varepsilon,\varepsilon]) + 10(\|\nabla f\|-1)^2,\ \varepsilon = 0.1,$$ $$\mathrm{reward} = f(s,a,s')\ \text{(raw logit)},\qquad \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{BC}} = -\mathbb{E}_E\log\pi(a|s) - 0.5\,\mathbb{H}[\pi],\ \text{12 steps/update}.$$
diff_from_baseline: Versus AIRL, keeps the shaped network but trains the discriminator with GAIL BCE + label smoothing + WGAN-GP and uses raw f(s,a,s') as reward; adds a 12-step BC head per round with an unusually large 0.5 entropy bonus that explicitly prevents the policy std from collapsing.
